_help: A questline (scripts/main.lua). The giver is a cat of the mod's own (Game.npcs): empty 'at', they turn up beside you the first time. Steps, in order: 'talk' (lines the giver says), 'collect' (items to pick up from then on, by tag), 'visit' (an actor class to go to, the nearest one, e.g. the medicine cat, or 'at': [x, y, z]). The last step's 'reward' is dropped at your paws. 'progress' is where you are; the quest's page in the mod menu can start it over.
title: The Moonlit Path

talk: Ah, a young cat with keen eyes. Will you help an old elder?
My bones ache in the cold. Bring me moss for my nest, and I'll tell you a secret.
Soft as a kit's fur. Thank you.
Now, the secret: some herbs open only under the moon. Ask your Clan's medicine cat what they know.
So the medicine cat knows of them too. Then the old stories are true.
Take these, young one, for your kindness. May StarClan light your path.
